sentences.text: Mucopolysaccharidosis type 4A is linked to the gene GALNS, and type 4B to the gene GLB1, both in curated databases [e_63fa8cbbaacd] [e_ebcdbdec8f81].
Both genes take part in the same curated pathway, keratan sulfate degradation [e_9addb76c341d] [e_10f453590dd2].
Constellate computed that types 4A and 4B look quite alike in their listed symptoms, with a score of 0.653, which is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_0fa2808718e6].
For type 4A, a beak-like bump on the lower spine bones and a forward curve of the lower spine are observed features [e_5d0f634de678] [e_336fb95e5c8c].
Both observations rest on small counts, 1 of 1 in the records [e_5d0f634de678] [e_336fb95e5c8c].
Intellectual disability is marked as contradicted for type 4A, with 1 contradicting record [e_ccf4609930ce].
These edges list no symptoms for type 4B [e_ebcdbdec8f81].
They also show no studies, funding or patient groups for either type [e_63fa8cbbaacd].
